title: A morphism of schemes is finite if and only if it is affine and proper
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Then $f$ is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] if and only if $f$ is affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism] and proper [def-weil-proper-morphism].
